name: mission-pipeline
description: Human-in-the-loop multi-agent engineering workflow: a PM aligns with the principal, decomposes missions into tasks, fans them out to parallel groups (Constructor builds, Crititor reviews, Stabilizer judges a bounded loop), schedules waves via a read-only Architect, calibrates each wave boundary against a frozen mission Charter, and closes on the principal's acceptance — in person, or by standing delegation with item-by-item repudiation — state derived from the documents agents write by a deterministic, agent-internal substrate (one seal call per artifact; append-only journal + rebuildable SQLite).
